purpose: Random parts that are rejected and regenerated at mint time. Screened against the six-character random field only, never against the series or check character.
notes: The Crockford alphabet already excludes U, which removes most obscenity risk by construction (IB0192 R1). What remains is screened here.
Substrings are matched anywhere within the six-character random field, case-insensitively.
Rules catch random parts that do not LOOK random - a code reading as a test value or placeholder invites a stranger to assume the card is not real.
Rejection costs one more draw from a space of 1,073,741,824 values per series. The screen is free.
Rules are declared, not expressed as regex, so that no escaping convention sits between this file and the processor that reads it.

rules.reason: Four or more identical characters in a row does not read as random.
Reads as a placeholder or test value rather than a minted code.
